rules.title: Security Deposit Handling and Return
rules.requirement: A lessor must hold security deposits in a separate account beyond the claim of creditors and provide a receipt to the tenant within 30 days. Interest at 5% per year must be paid to the tenant annually or upon tenancy termination. The lessor must return the security deposit within 30 days after tenancy ends, deducting only unpaid rent, tax increases per tax escalation clauses, and reasonable repair costs for tenant-caused damage excluding normal wear and tear. The lessor must provide an itemized list of damages with evidence. The security deposit must be transferred to any successor in interest with notification to the tenant. Failure to comply results in forfeiture of the right to retain the deposit and potential damages to the tenant.
rules.summary_plain: Your landlord must keep your security deposit in a special account, pay you interest yearly, and return it within 30 days after you move out, minus any allowed deductions. They must give you a detailed list if they deduct for damages. If the property is sold, the new owner must take over the deposit and notify you.
rules.summary_plain_es: Su arrendador debe mantener su depósito de seguridad en una cuenta especial, pagarle intereses anualmente y devolverlo dentro de los 30 días posteriores a que se mude, menos las deducciones permitidas. Deben darle una lista detallada si deducen por daños. Si la propiedad se vende, el nuevo propietario debe hacerse cargo del depósito y notificarle.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to all residential real property leases except those for 100 days or less for vacation or recreational purposes.
rules.exemptions_text: Leases of 100 days or less for vacation or recreational purposes are exempt.
rules.penalty: Damages equal to three times the security deposit plus interest, court costs, and attorney's fees if the lessor fails to comply with deposit handling requirements.
